reason: The handler performs a browser history back navigation and then calls setIncludeSnapshot(), indicating the response will include a snapshot of the resulting page. That can return page contents from authenticated/local/intranet contexts into the agent context, so SECRET is supported, and web page content can be attacker-controlled, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution; browser navigation is not HOSTEXEC. They also do not show agent-supplied data being sent to an attacker-readable destination, so SINK is not supported.
